lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 저는 오늘 새로 온 하준이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Hi. I'm Hajun, I just joined today.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. jeoneun oneul saero on hajunieyo.
lines.learner: 반가워요. 저는 수아예요. 제 친구도 소개할게요.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Sua. Let me introduce my friend too.
lines.roman: bangawoyo. jeoneun suayeyo. je chingudo sogaehalgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Since when have you been close?
lines.learner: 초등학교 때 친구가 됐는데, 지금도 늘 같이 다녀요.
lines.en: We became friends in elementary school, and we're still always together.
lines.roman: chodeunghakgyo ttae chinguga dwaenneunde, jigeumdo neul gachi danyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Does Jimin have a good personality?
lines.en: Yes, Jimin is quiet but gets along well with friends.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, a good friend. Is Jimin good at studying too?
lines.en: Good at math, but finds English a bit hard.

lines.beaver_en: Do the teachers know Jimin too?
lines.en: Yes, Jimin often gets praise from teachers.

lines.beaver_en: Do the seniors know Jimin too?
lines.en: Yes, Jimin is close with the soccer club seniors too.

lines.beaver_en: I'd like to get close with Jimin too.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 지민이는 착한데 처음에는 말이 적어요.
lines.en: Great. Jimin is kind but doesn't talk much at first.
lines.roman: joayo. jiminineun chakande cheoeumeneun mari jeogeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then when can I meet Jimin?
lines.en: Let's meet at lunchtime. I'll tell Jimin.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks, Sua. See you at lunch!
lines.learner: 네, 하준 씨도 지민이랑 잘 어울릴 거예요.
lines.en: Sure, I think you'll get along well with Jimin too.
lines.roman: ne, hajun ssido jiminirang jal eoullil geoyeyo.
